S18-MX-001.title: Mail exchanger configuration
S18-MX-001.remediation: Publish MX records for domains that receive mail. For domains that never receive mail, publish a null MX ("0 .") together with "v=spf1 -all".

S18-SPF-001.title: SPF record missing
S18-SPF-001.remediation: Publish one TXT record beginning "v=spf1" that lists every legitimate sending service and ends with ~all or -all.

S18-SPF-002.title: Multiple SPF records
S18-SPF-002.remediation: Merge all SPF mechanisms into a single v=spf1 record; multiple records cause a permanent error.

S18-SPF-003.title: Permissive SPF all-qualifier
S18-SPF-003.remediation: End the SPF record with -all (fail) or ~all (softfail paired with an enforcing DMARC policy). Never use +all.

S18-SPF-004.title: SPF DNS-lookup limit exceeded
S18-SPF-004.remediation: Reduce include:, a, mx, ptr and exists terms to ten or fewer DNS lookups, flattening includes where necessary.

S18-DMARC-001.title: DMARC record missing or invalid
S18-DMARC-001.remediation: Publish exactly one TXT record at _dmarc.<domain> beginning "v=DMARC1" with a policy and an aggregate-report address.

S18-DMARC-002.title: DMARC policy not enforcing
S18-DMARC-002.remediation: After reviewing aggregate reports and aligning SPF and DKIM for legitimate senders, move from p=none to p=quarantine and then p=reject.

S18-DMARC-003.title: Partial DMARC enforcement
S18-DMARC-003.remediation: Raise pct to 100 once legitimate mail is aligned so the policy applies to all failing messages.

S18-DMARC-004.title: DMARC aggregate reporting not configured
S18-DMARC-004.remediation: Add rua=mailto:<monitored address> so the owner receives aggregate authentication reports.

S18-DKIM-001.title: DKIM key for supplied selector
S18-DKIM-001.remediation: Publish the sending service's DKIM public key at <selector>._domainkey.<domain> and enable signing; rotate keys of 2048 bits or more periodically.

S18-MTASTS-001.title: MTA-STS not enforced
S18-MTASTS-001.remediation: Publish _mta-sts TXT (v=STSv1; id=...) and serve a policy at https://mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt listing every MX, moving from mode: testing to mode: enforce.

S18-TLSRPT-001.title: SMTP TLS reporting not configured
S18-TLSRPT-001.remediation: Publish _smtp._tls.<domain> TXT "v=TLSRPTv1; rua=mailto:<address>" to receive SMTP TLS failure reports.

S18-SMTP-001.title: Inbound SMTP STARTTLS
S18-SMTP-001.remediation: Enable STARTTLS on every MX host with a publicly trusted certificate whose name matches the MX hostname.

S18-CAA-001.title: CAA record missing
S18-CAA-001.remediation: Publish CAA records naming only the certificate authorities the organisation uses, optionally with an iodef contact.

S18-DNSSEC-001.title: DNSSEC not deployed
S18-DNSSEC-001.remediation: Sign the zone at the DNS provider and publish the resulting DS record at the registrar to complete the chain of trust.

S18-DNSSEC-002.title: Broken DNSSEC chain of trust
S18-DNSSEC-002.remediation: Urgently either restore zone signing so it matches the published DS record, or remove the DS record at the registrar.

S18-NS-001.title: Insufficient nameserver redundancy
S18-NS-001.remediation: Delegate at least two authoritative nameservers, preferably on separate networks.

S18-REG-001.title: Domain registration expiry
S18-REG-001.remediation: Renew the registration, enable auto-renew and keep registrar contact details current.

S18-REG-002.title: Registrar transfer lock not set
S18-REG-002.remediation: Enable the registrar transfer lock (clientTransferProhibited) and, where offered, registry lock for critical domains.
